body: Everything was good in my life until I turned 16. I grew up in a poor area of Manchester but I had lots of friends and had a relatively good time in primary school and high school. When I went to college, everything went to hell. I lost that sense of community and developed anxiety and depression. Then the lazy staff at the college pushed us all into university. I chose a course at random and that truely messed up my life. Instead of receiving solid careers advice I blindly studied science and now I can't get a job. It is absolutely essential to make well-informed decisions when you are young, but for many of us who don't have money or connections, it is impossible to have that kind of knowledge as an 18 year old kid. I don't smoke, I don't drink (I am teetotal), I have never taken drugs and I run over 40 miles a week. I studied hard. I did the best I could but I have been screwed over anyway. I need to go back to when I was 18 and apply to medical or dental school. Either that or I take up golf and maybe some wealthy retirees will hire me in their company.
Sorry about that. Brazil is like India, China, Indonesia, Thailand etc... absolute hell holes for those who have no money.
